column4: Description
logos repo, conventions and the dev loop.

column3: Create logos repo and push foundation and services
column4: Acceptance criteria: Repo developer-az/logos exists with services/, foundation docs and addons/; main protected, CI required.
Acceptance criteria: Root README explains the system in one diagram and how to run it in one command; CONTRIBUTING covers branch naming with Jira keys.
Acceptance criteria: All projects target net10.0; tests and integration tests green; Dockerfile uses 10.0 images (D-6).
Acceptance criteria: Compose uses the same Kafka major version as the cluster; kafka-ui swapped to kafbat/kafka-ui (D-8, D-9).
C# saga over Kafka (services thread).

column3: Order and inventory saga with outbox and inbox
column4: Acceptance criteria: Built: place, confirm, reject, cancel; no overselling under concurrency; integration tests over real Kafka and PostgreSQL.
Acceptance criteria: Services accept SCRAM username, password and CA path from config; connect to Strimzi TLS listener in a kind test.
Acceptance criteria: Order service looks up unit prices instead of trusting the client; price change event published.
Acceptance criteria: Confirmed orders produce shipment.requested; documented in events.md.
Acceptance criteria: Endpoint or CLI lists dead letters with error headers and re-publishes selected ones.
TypeScript API and UI over the event streams, tested with Jest.
Acceptance criteria: Node service consumes orders and inventory events, dedupes on eventId, ignores unknown eventTypes, keeps highest version per SKU.

column3: Projection logic unit tests in Jest
column4: Acceptance criteria: Jest covers out-of-order versions, duplicate events, unknown types, saga state per correlationId; coverage gate in CI.
Acceptance criteria: SSE or WebSocket stream of order status and stock levels; Jest tests for the HTTP and stream layer.
Acceptance criteria: Page shows stock per SKU, order funnel (placed, confirmed, rejected, cancelled) and a per-order saga timeline by correlationId.
Acceptance criteria: Fixture events shared with the C# tests; both sides fail if the envelope or payloads drift.
Run logos on a real cluster with automated delivery.
Acceptance criteria: GitHub Actions: dotnet test (with integration tests via Docker), Jest with coverage, kustomize render; required on PRs.

column3: Images to GHCR tagged by SHA
column4: Acceptance criteria: Main builds and pushes order, inventory and dashboard images.
Acceptance criteria: Deployments, Services, probes, PDBs, resources for order, inventory, dashboard; PostgreSQL via operator or managed DB; ProvisionTopics off.
Acceptance criteria: deploy/k8s/kafka applied; topics and SCRAM users match events.md; secrets synced to the app namespace.

column3: Local kind bring-up in one command
column4: Acceptance criteria: Script creates kind, installs Strimzi, deploys everything, runs an end-to-end order smoke test.
Acceptance criteria: Ingress + cert-manager on the chosen cluster; dashboard public, write APIs rate-limited or behind a key.
Acceptance criteria: Deployment that places and cancels realistic orders continuously so the demo is always live.
Acceptance criteria: OpenTelemetry traces across HTTP and Kafka using correlationId; Grafana panels for consumer lag, DLT rate, saga latency.
Acceptance criteria: Merges to main deploy automatically (Argo CD or Actions); rollback documented.
Make Jira part of how logos is built, not just where tasks sit.
Acceptance criteria: Epics and stories created in the logos Jira project with parents and points.

column3: Link commits and PRs to Jira
column4: Acceptance criteria: Branch names and PR titles carry issue keys; GitHub for Jira app shows dev status on issues.
Acceptance criteria: addons/jira-flow deployed against the logos board; lead and cycle time P50/P85 shown on the dashboard.
